mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, the temperature is 77 degrees under clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in its third quarter phase tonight, and the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning at 3:35 AM, rising over the area near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg. Looking ahead, the overnight low will be 74 degrees with rain predicted.

There are two major updates for the city. First, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is underway to improve accessibility, with construction and bridge replacements beginning soon. Second, the city has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park, a beautiful tribute to local art and community values.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness or join the crowd for Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police recap, officers reported that on August 28, they were called to the area of Church Avenue and South Marietta Street for reports of ding-dong-ditching. Two juveniles were identified and officers provided warnings after contacting their parents.

We have finished serving our flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl, as the store is now closed for the evening. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow morning at 10 AM, when we will be featuring the Chocolate Volcano flavor.
